correctness.rationale: Addition identity U_{m+k}=U_{k+1}U_m+U_kU_{m-1} bounds possible jumps by U_{k+1}≤19. The Binet-conjugate norm (α^k-10)(β^k-10) is nonzero integer, bounding source m independent of finite tests. The proof then divides a into exhaustive ranges: a≥20 none; 11..19 1→a; a=10 two edges; 5..9 none; a=4 one; a=3 three; a=2 two, with all jumps past the listed ones excluded by positivity and monotonicity. Independently enumerated recurrence values for 138 a values (2..139), tested all target pairs in initial range, and recovered every predicted edge, but the all-a proof is the seven-case algebra.
